Cities.reasoning: The column lists pairs of cities, representing the geographic locations or comparison sites of the study.

Diff.reasoning: This column contains the calculated difference (a numerical measurement) between the two locations.

Lwr.reasoning: This column provides the lower bound of the confidence interval, which is a measurement value.

Upr.reasoning: This column provides the upper bound of the confidence interval, which is a measurement value.

p-Value.reasoning: This column records the statistical significance (p-value) of the comparison.
